alex: Hey team — quick design review on the first-run / onboarding flow. Pushed a prototype to Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/onboarding-v6 — would love quick take on banners vs modal checklist.

maria: Skimmed figma — love the idea of a persistent top banner for quickstart, but worried it clutters console header at smaller widths.

priya: +1 on banner for discoverability. Can we make it collapsible and keyboard-accessible? e.g., `button aria-expanded` and store collapse in localStorage so it doesn't reappear every session.

evan: If we go banner, prefer subtle microcopy: "Try the Quickstart: 5 mins to first inference" rather than long explainer. Also A/B test CTA text: `Create sample project` vs `Run quick demo`.

samir: Accessibility nits: contrast on green CTA in artboard A is 3.8:1 — fails AA. Suggest darker green or outline style. Also need visible focus ring on the dismiss `x` and on banner CTA when tabbing.

alex: Good catches. I also mocked a modal checklist as fallback when users click the banner CTA (so banner is low-friction, modal has the checklist). Modal has steps: 1) Add API key, 2) Pick a sample project, 3) Run demo, 4) Save route. See frame 05 in Figma.

maria: One UX question: should the checklist be checklist-style (user ticks off) or a guided flow with next/back? My read: checklist is better for returning users who want to skip steps. Guided flow better for first-timers.

priya: Could combine: default to guided flow on first-run, then convert to checklist for subsequent visits. Use a small toast: "You can switch to checklist view anytime". Also add `aria-live` updates when step status changes for screen readers.

ev an: (oops) typo — meant evan. Re: sample projects, can we ship 3 starters: `assistant-chat`, `file-search`, `summarize-batch` — each with one-click deploy + prefilled prompts. Keep sizes tiny so demo runs in hosted tier.

alex: Good set. Also adding telemetry events: `onboarding.shown`, `onboarding.cta_clicked`, `onboarding.step_completed`, `onboarding.opt_out`. Product needs these for conversion funnels.

samir: For copy variants, propose two short options to test: A) "Get started — build a demo in 5 minutes" B) "Quickstart — your first inference, fast". Which aligns with PLG tone? Maria?

maria: I like A for marketing clarity. B might sound too generic. Keep CTAs action-first: `Get started` > `Quickstart`.

priya: Accessibility addition: images in sample project cards need meaningful alt text and avoid conveying same info as copy. Also ensure keyboard order matches visual order when modal expands.

alex: UX dev asks: any thoughts on showing token cost estimate on sample projects (e.g., "~1.2¢ / request")? Could help set expectations but also adds cognitive load.

evan: I think show it in microcopy under advanced details only. Maybe a small `i` icon that opens a tooltip with cost estimate and model used. Keep default CTA uncluttered.

samir: Also add an accessibility mode toggle in the modal that increases focus styles and uses larger hit targets — opt-in for assistive users.

maria: For placement: mobile breakpoint should collapse banner into an inline `Quickstart` row under header, not overlay. We should test 360px screens.

priya: One more micro-copy tweak: instead of "Add API key" maybe "Connect API key (secure)" clarifies safety. But not sure if parentheses help. Thoughts?

alex: I prefer concise: `Connect API key`. We have a security badge on the modal header for reassurance.

onboarding-bot: Reminder: user research session tomorrow 11:00am with 4 participants focusing on first-run flow. Recording will be stored in #research.

maria: Great — I'll bring the Figma flows and the 2 copy variants for the prototype. Can someone whip up the sample project JSON bundles for the demo?

evan: I can prepare minimal manifests for the three starters and add a `run-demo.sh` script that swaps in an ephemeral key. Will push to `platform/onboarding-demos` repo.

alex: Action items summary: 1) Evan to add sample project manifests + demo scripts (due EOD tomorrow). 2) Priya to update modal for aria-live, focus rings, and contrast fixes (PR draft by Wed). 3) Maria to prepare prototype copy A/B and run with user sessions. 4) Samir to draft accessibility toggle requirements. 5) Product to add telemetry events to tracking plan.

samir: Tiny follow-up: add a `skip tutorial` link that's keyboard-reachable and has `aria-label=\"Skip onboarding tutorial\"`.

priya: Noted. Also will add unit tests for keyboard nav (tab order) in storybook.

alex: Awesome. No blockers flagged. If nobody objects, we'll land banner+modal pattern and iterate from research results. :shipit: 

maria: Sounds good. @evan once you push manifests, tag me and I'll hook up the deploy button in prototype.

evan: Will do.

alex: Thanks everyone — closing thread.
